_comment: Machine-readable facts for this project. Every entry must carry how it was established. If a fact is listed as 'measured' the measurement exists in NOTES.md or docs/. Anything not here should be re-measured, not remembered. This file exists because the session was compacted twice and the same facts (menu keys, room meaning, mouse calibration) were re-derived several times.

control_files.state: /tmp/nid_state_<id>.txt  (them_x them_y me_x me_y have154 have242 - NOTE names are unreliable, see player_identity)
control_files.instances: /tmp/nid_insts_<id>.txt  (id object_index x y, one line per instance)
control_files.click: /tmp/nid_click_<id>.txt  (window-content x y, posts a real CGEvent click)
control_files.DANGER_room_cmd: /tmp/nid_room_<id>.txt is a room_goto COMMAND; a stale value there kills the game ('Game ended before loading first room')

launch_env_required.NID_THREAD: 1 - without it the hook's probe thread never starts, so there are no state files at all
launch_env_required.NID_SHOW: 1 - keeps the window on screen; MEASURED 120-320 fps visible vs ~24-30 fps parked
launch_env_required.NID_NICE: unset by default; setting it applies nice 19 + background QoS, which MEASURED 4x slower

visibility.policy: game MAY be visible; it MUST be muted. Relaxed 2026-11-08 by the user.
visibility.measured: visible 120-320 fps vs ~24-30 fps parked (macOS throttles an essentially-offscreen window), so visible is 2x-5x faster and now the default
visibility.mute_mechanism: the game's own prefs only: prefs.ini [audio] unmuted=0 and musicVol=0, restored from prefs_locked.ini at every launch and chmod 444 during a run. NEVER touch the Mac system volume.
visibility.env: NID_VISIBLE=1 (default in the launcher); NID_HIDDEN=1 parks the window for a 2x slowdown

rooms.source: decompiled from Contents/Resources/game.ios by a pi subagent; table in docs/ROOM_NAMES.md; 82 rooms
rooms.arenas: 26-77 excluding 69 and 78 (castle / mines / sky / wilds / cemetery sections)
rooms.note: the title screen's attract demo runs INSIDE an arena room (29 rCastleCenter), so room index alone cannot distinguish demo from match

keys.W: does NOT move the main menu

menu.structure: the list SCROLLS under a FIXED highlight bar; the bar sits at the same screen position regardless of selected row
menu.highlight_bar_capture: in a 1920x1256 capture of a 960x628 window the bar spans image y 836-886; grey value 30 at x=0.33W
menu.consequence: the selected row can only be identified by the TEXT under the bar (band template matching, see nav3.py), never by a coordinate
menu.danger: pressing Enter inside OPTIONS cycles the LANGUAGE row: measured flips to French and then Chinese
menu.verified_path: fresh launch -> Enter -> (S x5 from MULTIPLAYER) -> Enter -> S -> Enter -> Enter -> S -> Enter -> Enter => room 2 -> 17 -> 29

player_identity.source: measured by holding D/A and diffing every instance (session 220)
player_identity.finding: the object index of the player DIFFERS BY ROOM: object 154 answered in one arena (D +64, A -25), object 244 in another; the other object did not move at all
player_identity.consequence: no fixed me/them slot mapping is correct; the authoritative fighter is the one that RESPONDS to D -> right and A -> left (bind_by_response)
player_identity.hook_labels: the state file's first pair (them_*) comes from object 154, the second (me_*) from object 242 - neither is reliably 'us'

timing.hook_key_hold: 12 frames per press; MEASURED: at 30 fps that was 200 ms, at 120 fps 100 ms - this made menu presses stop registering when fps changed
timing.boot_wait: 48 s after launch before entry keys
timing.round_settle: the round does not accept input immediately after entering the arena; ~4 s settle was needed before binding succeeded

verified_pipeline.attest: python tools/attest.py -> 'VERDICT: ATTESTED' (room ok / bind ok / gate ok / opponent ok). Evidence in out/ATTESTED
verified_pipeline.gate: direction gate: hold D and require the bound instance to move right, hold A and require left; both must pass
verified_pipeline.doctor: python tools/doctor.py -> environment health (processes, priority, fps, room, file freshness, stale command file)

open: no verified round transition has ever been observed, so rounds_won is 0 and no win rate exists
the round counter in the reward cannot fire; fitness rests on net kills and territory only
menu navigation works but is slow (band capture + scroll per step)

windows_build.source: strings over ~/nidfarm/game/data.win on artemis (the patched copy), 2026-11-09, worker 2 (prober) + worker 1 (engineer)
windows_build.note: NEWER than the macOS game.ios build the rooms table above came from (2025-10-30). Room INDICES and menu structure differ - do NOT cross-trust the macOS table for the artemis build. The grid reached after SINGLE PLAYER is VsLevelSelect (MAP select), NOT room 17 rLevelSelect.
windows_build.training: solo, fight the CPU on any map without Arcade; menu = personality list (~15: BRAWLER, DIVEKICKER, DIVEKICK ONLY, LUNGE, NEVER LUNGES, NO DIVEKICKS, NO THROWS, PARRY MASTER, RANDOM, RUN N LUNGE, THROWS ONLY, ...) then AI DIFFICULTY, MAP/CHANGE LEVEL, START. The CPU brain (createBrainForPlayer) is assigned ONLY by walking this menu; skipping it leaves the CPU passive/frozen.

mode_semantics.CPU_BATTLE: watch-only: two CPU fighters fight each other, no drivable P1 (help text: "CPU BATTLE pits two CPU fighters against each other")
mode_semantics.TRAINING: solo vs CPU on any map, needs personality + difficulty menus to create the CPU brain (help text: "the new Training mode lets you fight the CPU on any map")
mode_semantics.ARCADE: coin-gated solo vs CPU progression (strings: COINS TO PLAY, ADD CREDIT, insert coin, hasEnoughCoins, spendCoins, getArcadeModeDifficulty, addArcadeModeLevel)
mode_semantics.frozen_READY_signature: the ready-up lobby of offline multiplayer/tournaments, NOT arcade (string: "Offline multiplayer now uses the same ready-up lobby as online mode")
mode_semantics.brain_creation: createBrainForPlayer/createBrainForFighter + addToPlayerIndexBrain run only via the menu path that sets personality/difficulty (TRAINING), or a mode that assigns a brain

net_test_autostart_flags.source: STRG strings over ~/nidfarm/game/data.win (strg_dump.py) + macOS symbol table (NOTES.md Session 48), 2026-11-09 worker 1 (engineer)
net_test_autostart_flags.route: the game is a YYC build (data.win has NO CODE chunk; GML compiled into Nidhogg.exe 25.6MB PE32+ x86-64 which embeds gml_Script_net_test_autostart). net_test_autostart parses -net* flags and calls startMatch directly (skip menus).

flags.-netai: boolean - opponent gets an AI brain
flags.-netarcade: start a local arcade match from the title screen

net_test_autostart_flags.measured: -netai ALONE leaves the opponent FROZEN (0px in four consecutive 6s windows; sustained_check.py). The single-window opp_moves=True at ~75s was a scripted spawn/intro walk. So the brain needs the personality+difficulty globals too.
net_test_autostart_flags.arcade_operator: arcade_settings.ini in AppData/Roaming/Nidhogg holds coinsPerPlay (0=FREE PLAY), aiDifficulty, winnerStaysOn. Only OLD prefix ~/nidpfx has it; active farm prefixes ~/nidfarm/prefixes/{1,2} LACK it, so earlier coin-gate probes seeded the wrong prefix.

linux_menu_walk.source: 2026-11-09 worker 1 (engineer) live probes on :99 (screen_state.py + frame pixel classify + enter_training_linux.py)
linux_menu_walk.boot_to_menu: fresh launch -> title/attract (big YELLOW region ~22k px) -> Return -> MAIN MENU (bright: yellow ~15k + orange ~33k px)
linux_menu_walk.training_walk: main menu -> w (SINGLE PLAYER) -> Return (submenu) -> s (TRAINING) -> Return -> PARTNER LIST (DARK screen, white text on black, mean~27) -> Return (pick partner) -> DIFFICULTY submenu
linux_menu_walk.blocker: the DIFFICULTY submenu has 3 rows (AI DIFFICULTY / MAP-CHANGE-LEVEL / START per facts.windows_build); navigating to MAP/CHANGE-LEVEL and pressing Return opens the VsLevelSelect grid which RENDERS BLACK (mean~6.5) and answers keys (Return/Up exits back to the menu). enter_training_linux.py only presses ONE s (DIFFICULTY->START) so it selects MAP/CHANGE-LEVEL and lands in the black grid instead of START.
linux_menu_walk.correction_2026-11-09: the 'AI DIFFICULTY / MAP / START' 3-row reading is UNVERIFIED. STRG index 5668 'AI DIFFICULTY' is actually the ARCADE OPERATOR MENU label (5663 OPERATOR MENU / 5664 COINS TO PLAY region), not the training menu. The game's own -lttraining localtest shows the real training flow is: personality list -> DIFFICULTY WINDOW (separate screen) -> ONE press -> rLevelSelect (map select) -> START. So the dark 3-row screen after 'pick partner' is most likely the DIFFICULTY WINDOW (3 difficulty levels), not a row-list menu.
linux_menu_walk.flag_route: (-netlevel training -netai -netpersonality brawler -netdiff 3) boots to rOnlineLobby ready-up flow, NOT a training match (claim 1584456f).

training_flow_localtest.flow: main menu (120 steps) -> 'do TRAINING' -> training list (personality, detected in 9 steps) -> difficulty window (detected in 0 steps) -> beat cmd 6 (press) -> rLevelSelect -> [CRASH: TrainingMenu object 215 destroyed, timing race at difficulty->map transition]
training_flow_localtest.consequence: the difficulty window is a SEPARATE screen between the personality list and the map select. The manual walk must pick a personality, then handle the difficulty window, then the (black-rendering) map select, then START.

linux_procs_bug.bug: nid_linux.py stop() UNLINKS nidfarm/procs.json, and every input primitive (key/keydown/keyup) reads _disp(i) from procs.json and silently no-ops when the entry is missing. launch_linux.sh does NOT write procs.json. So after stop()+launch_linux.sh, key() sends ZERO keys and entry scripts report bound=None as if entry failed.
linux_procs_bug.fix: register the live instance: write {"0":{"wrapper":0,"display":":99"}} to ~/nidfarm/procs.json after launch_linux.sh (or use nid_linux.start which writes procs.json).

lobby_walk_plates.finding: the ready-up 'walk onto the plates' is NOT a special key. lt_walk (gml_Script_lt_walk) logs '[seq] holding the walk until the lobby sequence is done' - it holds the fighter's OWN movement key (P1=d/a, P2=arrows) until BOTH fighters are on their plates.
evidence_strings: [seq] holding the walk until the lobby sequence is done
ready-up room: two fighters, two places
ready-up room: the plates wait for both of a side
lobby_walk_plates.consequence: prober's 20:25 probe moved only P1 (d, x=8->142) and left P2 parked, so the game saw 'never both ready' and never opened level select. Both fighters must be driven onto their plates simultaneously.
lobby_walk_plates.after_plates: from the game's own localtest log: level select (rLevelSelect) -> 'the pick timer starts the match' (~10s, NO pick key) -> arena -> 'round 2: X won' -> rMatchStats (auto-timeout ~10s) -> ready-up.

training_difficulty_window_20261109.finding: the difficulty window advances to rLevelSelect (room 17, map select) with exactly ONE press (claim sha d2ec7e39). It is a separate screen between the personality list and the map select.
training_difficulty_window_20261109.diagnosis: submenu_probe 21:01 shows 3 rows at game-y 70/126/139 but the grey highlight band moves 70->80->90 in 10px steps per s (NOT row-to-row ~55px jumps) -> row 1 (y~70) is a single-line CYCLE VALUE (difficulty), cycled by s or Left/Right, not a scrolling list row.
training_difficulty_window_20261109.map_select: training map select has NO picker countdown (string "training: no picker countdown, not a local session") so the player must pick a map + START manually; it renders BLACK on Linux (logic runs).

training_mode_20261109.training_mode: single-player Training mode: fight the CPU on any map without Arcade (patch-notes string)
training_mode_20261109.cpu_battle: CPU BATTLE = watch two CPU fighters (patch-notes string)
training_mode_20261109.pick_timer: level select has a pick timer that starts the match (string "the pick timer starts the match")
training_mode_20261109.levelselect_picker: one player is the picker; other player cannot start it
training_mode_20261109.untested: -ltcontrols and -ltteams and -ltshow5 never probed on artemis yet
